review_scope: Independent review approval. The Writer-stage receipt is completed by the reviewer: round-2 review of the corrected draft (article sha256 below) under rockb-v2.1. The round-1 rework request was the published offline-control command naming the adapter attribute 'fixture-reference' instead of the registry key run_tasks.py accepts; the Writer changed all four published occurrences to '--adapter reference' and this review re-executed the command verbatim from a fresh copy of the protocol in scratch (exit 0, 'RESULT: adapter=fixture-reference completed=4 partially=0 failed=0'). All six primary sources were re-fetched live over HTTPS on 2026-10-13 and every body is byte-identical to the researcher's capture; every material figure, scope qualifier and retry-policy attribution was checked against the source text. All 16 public_artifacts hashes match the tree, every recorded code/dataset hash inside fixture-report.json and first-party-run.json was re-derived and matches, and all 20 publication-gate risk blocks are covered. No model was run, no endpoint was contacted and no GPU time was used.
